mapper.select: select dc.id, dc.name, dc.symbol,dc.kingdee_code as kingdeeCode,dc.currency_num as currencyNum,dc.disabled from dict_currency dc where dc.is_deleted = false order by dc."index" asc

select id,name,symbol,kingdeeCode,currencyNum,disabled from ( select dc.id, dc.name, dc.symbol,dc.kingdee_code as kingdeeCode,dc.currency_num as currencyNum,dc.disabled from dict_currency dc where dc.is_deleted = false
and (dc.name ilike concat('%', #{params.searchKeyword}::text ,'%') or dc.id ilike concat('%', #{params.searchKeyword}::text ,'%'))
order by dc.index asc ) currency
